title: Two heads, graded separately
caption: RotNet outputs a walking distance (orange ring: every point that far from the first frame) and a unit direction (purple arrow), and each gets its own score. The left half shows the single-arrow alternative for contrast. Handing RotNet the true direction leaves only its small distance error. GIF

title: Right distance, wrong direction
caption: Even with the distance exactly right, a guess more than 60° off lands further from the truth than not moving at all (freeze). On new clips RotNet's direction is about 82° off; on training clips about 30°. GIF
